title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats
tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

exact_text.read_as: Rooftop Jazz (16:9); cropped to “…oftop Ja…” in 9:16
Sky Terrace, Manchester (16:9, wrapped); cropped to “…ky Terrac…” and “…anchest…” in 9:16

faults.what: The portrait version severely crops all event text at the side edges throughout the supplied frames, losing essential title, date and venue information.
The portrait crop cuts off musicians' faces at the side edges.
The portrait soundtrack transcription reports speech, “عشق است”, conflicting with the requested no-voiceover treatment.
The oversized text and large dark panel dominate both compositions and obscure much of the musical performance.

judge.summary: Two sunset rooftop promos were delivered, but the portrait version crops essential text and musicians and has reported speech in its soundtrack.

must_haves.item: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
must_haves.why: Two separate clips are identified with matching portrait and landscape frames, and both are reported as 10 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
must_haves.why: Both show formally dressed musicians performing on a rooftop against a warm sunset, with matching event graphics.

must_haves.item: Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
must_haves.why: All wording is exact in the landscape version, but none of the three strings is fully visible in the portrait version.

must_haves.item: All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: The landscape text remains readable across the sampled times, but the portrait text is cut off in every supplied frame.

must_haves.item: Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
must_haves.why: The imagery fills both formats without evident black bars or stretching, but the portrait framing cuts off musicians' faces.

must_haves.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The portrait audio transcript reports spoken words. The supplied transcription does not establish whether the music is mellow jazz.
